cohort: 69 women with placenta previa and placenta accreta who underwent elective cesarean delivery after 34 weeks of gestation
finding: While not impacting other outcomes, prophylactic balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta reduced the number of women experiencing estimated blood loss exceeding 1000 mL after cesarean delivery for abnormal placentation, particularly in cases of placenta accreta and increta.
mod_finding: Prophylactic balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta reduced the number of women experiencing estimated blood loss exceeding 1000 mL after cesarean delivery for abnormal placentation.
